subject: Conflicting reinforcement detail for the transfer beam between Sheet S-301 and Structural

messages.text: The transfer beam reinforcement shown in Sheet S-301 conflicts with a revised bar splice noted in Structural Detail 3/S502. We would like this resolved ahead of the next concrete pour. This may generate a change order depending on the direction taken. This is holding the concrete placement for this pour. Please respond by Thursday, ahead of Friday's pour.

Proceed with a revised bar splice per Structural Detail 3/S502; Sheet S-301 is superseded. This may generate a change order depending on the direction taken. This is holding the concrete placement for this pour.
To confirm before we place concrete: does this direction -- a revised bar splice -- apply at every transfer beam on this level, not just the one called out in Sheet S-301?
